## Summary / 变更摘要

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] Relevant tests / 相关测试
- [ ] `pnpm license:check`
- [ ] `pnpm release:check`

## Release safety / 发布安全

- [ ] No database, attachments, backups, real `.env`, credentials, private addresses, personal data, or business content is included.
- [ ] New dependencies and redistributed assets have compatible licenses and attribution.
